item.title: Alaska - Wikipedia
item.description: Alaska is the largest U.S. state by area —comprising more total area than the next three largest states of Texas, California, and Montana combined—and is the world's largest semi-exclave and seventh-largest subnational division.

item.title: Alaska Maps & Facts - World Atlas
item.description: Alaska, nicknamed, “The Last Frontier”, is a non-contiguous US state located in the extreme northwest of North America.

item.title: Alaska | Maps, Population, Capital, History, Flag, Cities, & Facts ...
item.description: Alaska, constituent state of the United States of America. It was admitted to the union as the 49th state on January 3, 1959. Alaska lies at the extreme northwest of the North American continent, and the Alaska Peninsula is the largest peninsula in the Western Hemisphere.

item.title: Geography of Alaska - Wikipedia
item.description: Alaska occupies the northwestern portion of the North American continent and is bordered only by Canada on the east. It is one of two U.S. states not bordered by another state; Hawaii is the other.
